help.send: To send money, choose 1 Send money, pick your receiver, enter the amount, confirm, then enter your PIN. You get an SMS with a reference straight away.
help.track: Choose 2 on the main menu to see your transfer stages. You get SMS updates at each step.
help.fees: Your fee is {flatFee} + {percent}% (rounded down to {roundTo}). You see the exact fee and payout before you confirm. Your rate locks for {minutes} min.
help.collect: Tell your receiver to take their ID and the secret code from their SMS to a Mukuru agent. The reference alone is not enough. Never share the code.
help.safety: Never share your PIN or code. We never ask you for them by phone. Three wrong PIN attempts lock your account temporarily.
help.agent: Call an agent on {phone}; they are available {hours}.

ussd.languageReset: Language cleared. Dial again to choose.
ussd.error: Service busy. Nothing was sent. Dial again.
ussd.unknownNumber: This number is not registered. Visit a Mukuru agent to sign up.

errors.daily_limit: That is above your daily limit. Dial again.
errors.wrong_pin: Wrong PIN. {triesLeft} tries left. Dial again to retry.
errors.pin_locked: Too many tries. Try again later.
errors.quote_expired: Rate expired. Dial again for a new rate.
errors.quote_invalid: Rate expired. Dial again for a new rate.

sender.sent: Mukuru: {amount} sent to {name}. Ref {ref}. {name} gets {received}. Keep this SMS.
sender.in_transit: Mukuru: {ref} is on the way to {name}.
sender.ready: Mukuru: {ref} is ready. {name} can collect {received} at a Mukuru agent.
sender.collected: Mukuru: {name} collected {received} ({ref}). No need to call.
sender.failed: Mukuru: {ref} failed. {amount} did NOT reach {name}; being returned or not charged. Dial *130*999# or reply TRY to retry.
